conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m furious! My card was charged ₹12,000 for a subscription I canceled months ago!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry to hear that, sir. Can you provide the card number and merchant details?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s ending in three five six four, some streaming service. I want my money back now!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ve located the transaction. It’s a recurring charge. I’ll initiate a chargeback and block further charges.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: This is unacceptable! You should’ve stopped it earlier!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand your frustration. The chargeback is filed, and you’ll see a refund in 5-7 days.
